summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend tests all pass. BACKEND (pytest, 6/6): /api/wallet/status → 200 with {apple:false, google:false, missing:{apple:[...], google:[...]}}; /api/wallet/apple/SO-7F3K-92QX.pkpass?expires=2027-12-15 → 503; /api/wallet/google/SO-7F3K-92QX?expires=2027-12-15 → 503; both endpoints without expires → 422. FRONTEND (390x844 mobile web): sign-in path OK; Home shows expiry-nudge 'Your £10 voucher expires in 41 days'; tapping it lands on Rewards tab; home-refer-card present after scroll and opens /refer. Rewards header shows '2 vouchers ready to use'; voucher-v-9k2t08mw-expiring row shows 'Expires in 41 days · 18 October 2026'; voucher-v-7f3k92qx card shows 'Expires 15 December 2027'. Voucher sheet for expiring voucher: voucher-sheet-expiry-note 'Use it before 18 October 2026 — after that it lapses.' visible; both add-to-apple-wallet and add-to-google-wallet badges present. Tap add-to-apple-wallet → wallet-pass-preview shows 'Surrey Opticians', 'Sarah Whitfield', 'SO-9K2T-08MW'; wallet-preview-back returns to QR. Tap add-to-google-wallet → preview → simulate-wallet-button → toast 'Added to Google Wallet', badge label changes to 'Added to Google Wallet', card shows chip 'In Google Wallet'. Regression: opening voucher-v-7f3k92qx → simulate-till-scan-button → toast 'Voucher applied at the till', voucher moves to Used, header becomes '1 voucher ready to use'. Refer screen: refer-hero shows SARAH-5589; refer-copy-button → toast 'Code copied'; referral-r-01 'Point earned', referral-r-02 'Joined · first visit pending', referral-r-03 'Invite sent'; refer-share-button falls back to 'Couldn't open the share sheet' toast on web (acceptable). Back arrow returns to Account. QR codes render as real square black-on-cream patterns (verified visually in screenshots). No red-screen; no runtime errors; only pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings from Iteration 1.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing RN Web deprecation warning (already reported in iteration_1.json): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking on web. Reference: iteration_1 report.
Pre-existing RN Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/rewards.tsx:341-350; /app/frontend/src/ui/Card.tsx.

action_items: No functional fixes required — all Iteration 2 acceptance criteria pass.
Optional (carried from iteration 1): silence RN Web deprecations by migrating pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents and shadow* → boxShadow via Platform.select.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/wallet.py cleanly separates configuration (apple_ready/google_ready + missing lists) from pass building; 503 vs 422 semantics match spec (status still 200 when keys missing, pass endpoints 503; missing required Query(...) surfaces as 422 automatically).
frontend/src/api/wallet.ts correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (no hardcoded URL) and encodes voucher code with encodeURIComponent.

rewards.tsx onWallet() gracefully falls back to preview when status[provider] is false; addToWallet.mutate is called on real-link path AND simulate path, so voucher.wallet is set in either case — matches wallet-chip requirement.

data.ts uses a computed 41-day expiry (`today + 41`) for voucher v-9k2t08mw so the expiring flow is always live in the prototype regardless of today's date — verified: nudge text reads 'expires in 41 days', card row 'Expires in 41 days · 18 October 2026'.
ExpiryNudge.tsx picks the soonest voucher deterministically and pluralises correctly for >1 vouchers.
refer.tsx: Share.share fallback path catches errors and toasts 'Couldn't open the share sheet' — matches the web behaviour observed. Clipboard.setStringAsync used properly with await.
No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). QRCode component renders real square patterns via react-native-qrcode-svg (visible in screenshots).
seed_data_creation: None. Mock data in /app/frontend/src/api/data.ts is used as-is. Voucher v-9k2t08mw expiry is computed dynamically to today+41 days so the expiring flow is always demonstrable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signing keys for Apple/Google Wallet are intentionally absent in this env — 503 on the pass endpoints and the in-app preview fallback are the CORRECT behaviour, not bugs. State is in-memory only (mock.ts); every reload resets to signed-out. Wallet badges in the voucher sheet sit below the fold on 390x844; use page.dispatch_event('...', 'click') or eval scrollIntoView() rather than page.click() to bypass 'element outside viewport'. To read the demo SMS code, parse verify-demo-code's inner text with re.sub(r'\D','',text)[-6:]. Refer share on web is expected to toast 'Couldn't open the share sheet'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All acceptance items from the review request verified end-to-end on the public URL.
